review.notes: Full review of the head the r5 review read (no change in the folder). Both r5 findings concern the unchanged PR description and stand: R01 (P2) point count over finite extensions now has three owners (WeilConjectures #1208 extensionPointCount, DeligneWeightsAndPurity #929 finiteFieldPointCount/finiteFieldZeta) while the description says consumers are unaffected; R02 (P3) description does not name the SchemeAndStackFoundations revision #1656 that alone defines Scheme.toProEt. New P3: SSF §§2.10/2.15 cited for finite etale sites and descent (they are §0.9/§1.1); isNoetherianRing_algebra_iff cited from ModularCurves 4D but on main it is isNoetherianRing_strictHenselization_iff (the new name is only at #1808), Tau Ceti StrictHenselization missing from supplier row; Z_l,X said to be Mathlib's ellAdicSheaf by definition though that sheaf is Ab.{u}-valued and coefficients live in u+1; f^! base change (Stacks 0GLE) unnamed, the plain base change g'^*f^! -> f'^!g^* is not iso (origin of A^1); constructibleSheaf_iff_exists_global restricted to Noetherian space (095E: qcqs) and F.6 Gysin restricted to regular schemes (ILO XVI 2.5: none); Gauss-Bonnet called an arbitrary-field identity (Spec F_q: chi 0 vs deg c_0 1); F.4.5 dictionary theorems without locators (BS 6.8.14, 7.4.5, 7.4.7). Gate re-run OK (worker's run adds build=0); depcheck 236 roadmaps 2264 edges 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with 6 sorry warnings only; #check pass on all 8 declarations, no binder lost; one-tactic probe fails on all 6 theorems (no padding). Seeded sample verified against cached texts: Invertibility, EtaleFundamentalGroup/EtalePath (0BMY, 0BND, Tau Ceti Fiber/FundamentalGroup), Scheme Frobenius interfaces (Stacks 33.36 tags), decomposition/inertia (09EA-09EE, SGA1 V §2 pp.92-96), one essentially small model, Dbc/Dbctf (095W, 03TQ, 03TT), trait ring structure (04GP, 06LJ), point counts (Tau Ceti Count/FixedField, 03UG step 2, SplittingField 0), classical/pro-etale comparison and coefficient ring objects (BS 3.5.7, 5.2.6, 5.5.1-5.5.4, 6.5.1, 6.6.11), rational realization (BS 6.8.3-6.8.14, 7.4.10), continuous actions (09YQ), regular-immersion classes (LRZ 3.2.5, 3.3.2, 3.4.1), F.5 and F.6 theorems (0G2C, 0GLD, 0GLE; ILO XVI-XVII). Not verifiable: SGA 4, SGA 4.5, SGA 5, Huber, Fujiwara, Ribet (uncertified). One source misprint recorded (Stacks 03UG proof Step 1).
